LSO.note: Training is for community members, not civil servants.

facts.fact: Public Eye reports the Community Digital Inclusion Model was launched with UNDP and the Ministries of Education and Communications to turn school computer labs into centres giving underserved and remote communities digital access, skills training and e-government services.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Ministry of Education with UNDP

facts.fact: Public Eye reports the Community Digital Inclusion Model was launched with 40 newly trained digital ambassadors tasked to train at least 1,500 community members in the first week, in school labs opened to communities.

LSO.note: Digital payment of pensions and grants is an aim; no portal or service stated.
